record.question: A mother has been taking opioids (morphine) throughout pregnancy. The newborn shows shrill cry, irritability, tremors, and poor feeding. What condition does the nurse suspect?
record.explanation: Answer A: Neonatal abstinence syndrome. A newborn exposed to opioids in utero with irritability, tremors, shrill cry, and feeding difficulty may have neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome (neonatal abstinence syndrome). Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/hcp/clinical-care/neonatal-abstinence-syndrome.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
